# AMUD Dashboard
> AMUD (Advanced Modern Unified Dashboard) is a compiled Rust homelab control center and telemetry dashboard. Zero YAML configuration — SQLite + web UI. Live Proxmox LXC and Docker status, Plex/Jellyfin/Home Assistant integrations. ~26–35MB RAM idle on Proxmox.

## Official links
- Website & docs: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/
- Blog: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/blog

- Releases (binaries): https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases

## Quick install (Proxmox VE host)
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/main/setup-amud.sh | bash

## What AMUD is
- Two Rust binaries: amud-server (web UI, SQLite, WebSockets) and amud-agent (host/Proxmox/Docker telemetry)
- Config stored in SQLite (amud.db), edited via browser — no YAML config files
- Proxmox: native LXC install script, live RUNNING/STOPPED badges, optional start/stop
- Docker: two-container Compose stack with shared Unix socket
- Integrations: Plex, Jellyfin, Home Assistant, Proxmox VE API
- Security: Argon2id passwords, AES-GCM encrypted integration secrets, CSRF, rate limiting

## What AMUD is not
- Not a SaaS product — self-hosted only
- Not YAML-first configuration
- Not PHP, Node.js, or Laravel based

## Alternatives users compare
- Homepage (YAML config, widgets)
- Heimdall (PHP/Laravel bookmark portal)
- Homarr (Next.js dashboard)
